breach.name: QuestionPro
breach.title: QuestionPro
breach.summary: In May 2022, the survey website QuestionPro was the target of an extortion attempt relating to an alleged data breach. Over 100GB of data containing 22M unique email addresses (some of which appear to be generated by the platform), are alleged to have been extracted from the service along with IP addresses, browser user agents and results relating to surveys. QuestionPro would not confirm whether…

fields.name: IP addresses
fields.why: Approximate location at the time of use, and a way to correlate accounts across services.

fields.name: Email addresses
fields.why: The address becomes a confirmed, active target, expect more phishing, better aimed.

fields.name: Browser user agent details
fields.why: Adds detail to a profile that can be assembled from several breaches at once.

fields.name: Survey results
fields.why: Adds detail to a profile that can be assembled from several breaches at once.

actions: Expect better-aimed phishing. A message that already knows your name and where you have an account is the whole point of a breach like this.
breach.scale_line: That is about 82% of the population of Australia.
